## Checklist

- [ ] `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` pass
- [ ] `cd web && npm run build` passes (it type-checks the UI)
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the behaviour I changed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, real hostnames or personal data are in the diff or the logs
- [ ] Docs (`Docs.md`, `README.md`) are updated if behaviour or settings changed
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), see CONTRIBUTING
